articles.title_en: To mitigate or to adapt: How to deal with optimism, pessimism and strategic ambiguity?
articles.title_cn: 减缓还是适应：如何应对乐观、悲观与战略模糊？
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the effect of strategic ambiguity and heterogeneous attitudes towards such ambiguity on optimal mitigation and adaptation. Pessimistic players tend to invest more in mitigation, while optimists favor adaptation. When adaptation is more expensive than mitigation, three types of equilibria can obtain depending on the level and distribution of ambiguity aversion: (i) a mitigation equilibrium, (ii) an adaptation equilibrium and (iii) a mixed equilibrium with both adaptation and mitigation. The interaction between ambiguity attitudes and wealth distribution plays a crucial role for the aggregate environmental policy: a wealth transfer from pessimistic to optimistic agents increases total mitigation. A similar result applies to the choice of an optimal mitigation subsidy, which is shown to increase in optimism, but decrease following a transfer of income towards the more optimistic players. Finally, we show that under strategic ambiguity, the introduction of a non-binding standard can impact agents’ beliefs about their opponents’ behavior and as a result lower total equilibrium mitigation. Our results highlight the necessity to consider attitudes towards strategic ambiguity in the design of economic policies targeting climate change. They might also shed some light on the slow rate of convergence of environmental policies across countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了战略模糊性以及对此类模糊性的异质性态度对最优减缓与适应的影响。悲观参与者倾向于在减缓上投入更多，而乐观者则偏好适应。当适应比减缓更昂贵时，根据模糊厌恶的程度和分布，可以获得三种均衡类型：（i）减缓均衡，（ii）适应均衡，以及（iii）同时包含适应与减缓的混合均衡。模糊态度与财富分布之间的相互作用对总体环境政策至关重要：从悲观者向乐观者的财富转移会增加总减缓量。类似的结果适用于最优减缓补贴的选择，该补贴随乐观程度增加而增加，但随收入向更乐观参与者转移而减少。最后，我们表明在战略模糊下，引入非约束性标准可以影响参与者对对手行为的信念，从而降低总均衡减缓量。我们的结果强调了在设计针对气候变化的经济政策时考虑战略模糊态度的必要性。它们也可能有助于解释各国环境政策趋同速度缓慢的原因。

articles.title_en: Anti-herding by hedge funds and its implications for expected returns
articles.title_cn: 对冲基金的反羊群行为及其对预期收益的影响
articles.abstract_en: Utilizing a dataset of 1,899 U.S. hedge funds, we present evidence of anti-herding behaviour among the U.S. hedge fund managers. Hedge funds anti-herd irrespective of market volatility and credit deterioration conditions although funding illiquidity has a stronger effect on the formation of anti-herding behaviour across the majority of hedge fund schemes analysed. More importantly, we document significant economic implications of anti-herding and show that hedge funds associated with high degree of anti-herding earn significantly higher excess returns over those with low degree of anti-herding, particularly in the intermediate and long horizons up to one year. At the same time, hedge funds that anti-herd experience greater idiosyncratic volatility in subsequent periods, presenting a novel perspective to the relationship between anti-herding, idiosyncratic volatility and expected returns. While the finding of anti-herding in the hedge fund industry is not unexpected as the main attraction of hedge funds is to devise proprietary trading strategies that is based on private information, our findings provide novel insight to the link between idiosyncratic volatility and expected returns in the context of anti-herding in the hedge fund industry.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用包含1,899只美国对冲基金的数据集，我们提供了美国对冲基金经理中存在反羊群行为的证据。无论市场波动性和信用恶化状况如何，对冲基金均表现出反羊群行为，尽管在分析的大多数对冲基金方案中，资金流动性不足对反羊群行为的形成有更强的影响。更重要的是，我们记录了反羊群行为的显著经济影响，并表明具有高度反羊群行为的对冲基金所获得的超额收益显著高于低度反羊群行为的对冲基金，尤其是在中期和长期（最长一年）的时间范围内。同时，反羊群行为的对冲基金在随后的时期经历更大的特质波动，这为反羊群行为、特质波动与预期收益之间的关系提供了一个新颖的视角。虽然在对冲基金行业中发现反羊群行为并不意外，因为对冲基金的主要吸引力在于设计基于私人信息的专有交易策略，但我们的发现为特质波动与预期收益之间的联系提供了新的见解，特别是在对冲基金行业反羊群行为的背景下。

articles.title_en: A new institutional perspective on business associations: Filling a gap between firms and states in the dynamic analysis of Richard Day
articles.title_cn: 商业协会的新制度视角：填补理查德·戴动态分析中企业与国家之间的空白
articles.abstract_en: In much of his work, Richard H. Day was concerned with the dynamics of growth among firms, households, industries and entire economies, and the fact that normal processes could end up at multiple equilibria or even out of equilibrium. To his great credit, he made use of optimizing models based on rational expectations to examine how firms and their managers would react in ways that would deal with the obstacles facing them, in some cases with the help of suitable policies of democratic governments. The purpose of this analysis is to point to a number of circumstances in which one type of institution omitted from his analysis, namely, business associations, might be able to serve as a very useful intermediary between the firms and government in mitigating the risks and inefficiencies that otherwise might lead to unfortunate equilibria and disequilibria in which firms and entire economies might find themselves.
articles.abstract_cn: 在理查德·H·戴的许多著作中，他关注企业、家庭、行业和整个经济的增长动态，以及正常过程可能最终导致多重均衡甚至脱离均衡的事实。值得称赞的是，他利用基于理性预期的优化模型来考察企业及其管理者如何以应对所面临障碍的方式做出反应，在某些情况下借助民主政府的适当政策。本分析的目的在于指出一些情况，在这些情况下，他的分析中遗漏的一种制度类型，即商业协会，可能能够在企业与政府之间充当非常有用的中介，以减轻风险和低效率，否则这些风险和低效率可能导致企业及整个经济陷入不幸的均衡和失衡状态。

articles.title_en: Adaptive utility
articles.title_cn: 适应性效用
articles.abstract_en: This paper models the real-time adaptation of utility when individuals have a limited capacity to make fine distinctions. A simple adaptive mechanism is proposed that adapts utility to an arbitrary distribution of rewards in a way that is ultimately optimal, in terms of minimizing the probability of errors. A modified simple mechanism is approximately optimal in terms of maximizing expected utility. The model generates the so-called “hedonic treadmill” and induces a preference for rising consumption.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在个体进行精细区分能力有限的情况下，对效用的实时适应性进行建模。提出了一种简单的适应性机制，该机制以适应任意奖励分布的方式调整效用，最终在最小化错误概率方面达到最优。一种修正的简单机制在最大化期望效用方面近似最优。该模型产生了所谓的“享乐跑步机”效应，并引发了对消费增长的偏好。

articles.title_en: The endogenous formation of common pool resource coalitions
articles.title_cn: 公共池资源联盟的内生形成
articles.abstract_en: We present the results of framed field (lab-in-field) experiments designed to investigate the endogenous formation of common pool resource (CPR) coalitions when the resource is co-defended with costly monitoring by coalition members and sanctions for encroachment imposed by the government. The experiments were conducted with fishers who were members of Chile's territorial use rights fisheries (TURFs) and in the lab with Chilean university students. Consistent with theoretical predictions, the fishers frequently formed CPR coalitions, even when they could not deter outsider poaching. When the cost of monitoring was low, fishers frequently formed the grand coalition. Coalitions tended to be smaller when monitoring was more costly, but not significantly so. However, coalitions were significantly smaller when monitoring was not available relative to when the cost of monitoring was low. Fishers also invested in monitoring frequently and these investments reduced poaching. When coalitions formed, total harvest effort was curtailed and earnings for coalition members generally increased. Students formed coalitions less frequently, these coalitions tended to be small, and they infrequently invested in monitoring, even when it was profitable to do so. Consequently, student coalition members were not better off on average than under open access.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们展示了框架田野（实验室田野）实验的结果，旨在研究当资源由联盟成员以高昂的监督成本共同防御且政府实施侵占制裁时，公共池资源（CPR）联盟的内生形成。实验对象是智利领土使用权渔业（TURFs）的渔民，以及在实验室中的智利大学生。与理论预测一致，渔民经常形成CPR联盟，即使他们无法阻止外部偷猎。当监督成本低时，渔民经常形成大联盟。当监督成本更高时，联盟往往更小，但差异不显著。然而，与监督成本低时相比，当无法进行监督时，联盟显著更小。渔民还经常投资于监督，这些投资减少了偷猎。当联盟形成时，总捕捞努力量受到限制，联盟成员的收入通常增加。学生形成联盟的频率较低，这些联盟往往较小，并且他们很少投资于监督，即使这样做是有利可图的。因此，学生联盟成员的平均状况并不比开放准入时更好。

articles.title_en: Public investment as downward benefit distribution: Theory and evidence from China’s public–private partnership programs
articles.title_cn: 公共投资作为向下利益分配：来自中国公私合作项目的理论与证据
articles.abstract_en: Although previous studies have documented the political cycle of public investment in various countries, we still know little about its distributional consequences. We address this question by analyzing an emerging form of public infrastructure investment in China: public–private partnership (PPP). We argue that mayors use infrastructure investment to distribute benefits, thereby securing local compliance and support. Our empirical analysis draws on a unique dataset that matches PPP contracts with Chinese mayors who served from 2010 to 2017. We demonstrate a salient tenure effect: mayors decrease public investment over time during their tenure. Moreover, the tenure effect is more salient among mayors who lack local work experience. Contract-level evidence shows that mayors disproportionately allocate more investment to local firms, especially local state-owned enterprises, to garner local support. We show that the downward tenure effect is mainly driven by officials’ survival concerns rather than promotion incentives.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管以往研究记录了各国公共投资的政治周期，但对其分配后果仍知之甚少。我们通过分析中国一种新兴的公共基础设施投资形式——公私合作（PPP）来探讨这一问题。我们认为，市长利用基础设施投资来分配利益，从而确保地方服从和支持。我们的实证分析基于一个独特的数据集，该数据集将PPP合同与2010年至2017年间任职的中国市长相匹配。我们发现了显著的任期效应：市长在任期内随时间推移减少公共投资。此外，任期效应在缺乏地方工作经验的市长中更为显著。合同层面的证据表明，市长不成比例地将更多投资分配给本地企业，尤其是地方国有企业，以获取地方支持。我们表明，向下的任期效应主要由官员的生存关切而非晋升激励驱动。

articles.title_en: Reference-dependent self-control: Menu effects and behavioral choices
articles.title_cn: 参考依赖的自我控制：菜单效应与行为选择
articles.abstract_en: As is well-known, choices of a decision maker (DM) who attempts self-control in the face of temptation may exhibit menu effects and “non-standard” patterns. Existing models can accommodate some of these patterns but not others; e.g., they can explain self-control undermining menu effects, but not self-control enhancing ones. We introduce a model of self-control with the goal of better understanding and accounting for such effects. The basic idea underlying our model is that the DM experiences a psychological cost if she succumbs to temptation and chooses in a manner that is totally antithetical to her commitment preferences. To mitigate such costs, in any menu, her expression of self-control involves, first, eliminating a subset of alternatives that are worst according to her commitment preferences, with the elimination process being reference-dependent. Then, amongst the remaining alternatives, she chooses the best one according to her temptation preferences. Besides studying menu effects, we characterize the model behaviorally based on a novel axiom called WARP with norms. We also show that the model is well-identified.
articles.abstract_cn: 众所周知，在面临诱惑时试图进行自我控制的决策者（DM）的选择可能表现出菜单效应和“非标准”模式。现有模型可以容纳其中一些模式，但不能容纳其他模式；例如，它们可以解释自我控制削弱菜单效应，但不能解释自我控制增强菜单效应。我们引入了一个自我控制模型，旨在更好地理解和解释这些效应。我们模型的基本思想是，如果决策者屈服于诱惑，并以与其承诺偏好完全背道而驰的方式选择，她会经历心理成本。为了减轻这种成本，在任何菜单中，她的自我控制表现涉及首先消除一组根据其承诺偏好最差的备选方案，且消除过程是参考依赖的。然后，在剩余的备选方案中，她根据其诱惑偏好选择最佳方案。除了研究菜单效应外，我们还基于一个称为带规范的WARP的新公理来刻画模型的行为特征。我们还表明该模型是良好识别的。

articles.title_en: Cooperation in knowledge sharing and R&D investment
articles.title_cn: 知识共享与研发投资中的合作
articles.abstract_en: This paper reports a laboratory experiment that provides insights on cooperation in R&D investment when knowledge sharing decisions are endogenous. Specifically, there are two types of treatments: one in which participants decide on whether to share knowledge before they make their investment decisions and one where the knowledge sharing constellation is exogenously given, both with and without non-binding communication. The results show that there are behavioral spillovers between the decisions on knowledge sharing and investment. When exogenously set, the degree of symmetric knowledge sharing does not affect cooperation. Communication increases cooperation more when participants can decide on knowledge sharing.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文报告了一项实验室实验，该实验提供了当知识共享决策为内生时研发投资中合作的见解。具体而言，有两种处理类型：一种是在参与者做出投资决策之前决定是否共享知识，另一种是知识共享组合外生给定，两种情况均包含非约束性沟通和不包含非约束性沟通。结果表明，知识共享决策与投资决策之间存在行为溢出效应。当外生设定时，对称知识共享的程度不影响合作。当参与者可以决定知识共享时，沟通更能促进合作。

articles.title_en: Female labor market conditions and gender gaps in aspirations
articles.title_cn: 女性劳动力市场条件与志向的性别差距
articles.abstract_en: Aspirations for the future can influence investments made today, and gender gaps in aspirations can perpetuate gender gaps in outcomes. In this paper, we explore how the local labor market affects gender gaps in aspirations. Using a national longitudinal survey from Japan, we begin by documenting large gender differences in adolescents’ aspirations with respect to education, marriage, and fertility, as well as parental aspirations for their child’s education. We then show that these gender gaps – specifically, boys aiming for higher educational attainment as well as later marriage and fertility – are significantly smaller in municipalities with higher female employment. Consistent with this, we also find that female employment is associated with higher parental investments in girls relative to boys. We detect similar patterns when examining realized outcomes at age 19.
articles.abstract_cn: 对未来的志向会影响今天的投资，而志向的性别差距可能使结果的性别差距长期存在。在本文中，我们探讨了当地劳动力市场如何影响志向的性别差距。利用日本的一项全国性纵向调查，我们首先记录了青少年在教育、婚姻和生育方面的志向以及父母对其子女教育的志向存在巨大的性别差异。然后我们表明，这些性别差距——具体而言，男孩追求更高的教育程度以及更晚的婚姻和生育——在女性就业率较高的城市显著较小。与此一致，我们还发现女性就业与父母对女孩相对于男孩的更高投资相关。在考察19岁时的实际结果时，我们检测到类似的模式。

articles.title_en: Artificial intelligence and firm-level productivity
articles.title_cn: 人工智能和企业层面的生产力
articles.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is often regarded as the next general-purpose technology with a rapid, penetrating, and far-reaching use over a broad number of industrial sectors. The main feature of new general-purpose technology is to enable new ways of production that may increase productivity. However, to date, only a few studies have investigated the likely productivity effects of AI at the firm-level, presumably due to limited data availability. We exploit unique survey data on firms’ adoption of AI technology and estimate its productivity effects with a sample of German firms. We employ both a cross-sectional dataset and a panel database. To address the potential endogeneity of AI adoption, we also implement IV estimators. We find positive and significant associations between the use of AI and firm productivity. This finding holds for different measures of AI usage, i.e., an indicator variable of AI adoption, and the intensity with which firms use AI methods in their business processes.
articles.abstract_cn: 人工智能（AI）通常被认为是下一个通用技术，在众多工业领域中具有快速、渗透和深远的应用。新通用技术的主要特点是实现可提高生产率的新生产方式。然而，迄今为止，只有少数研究调查了人工智能在公司层面可能对生产力产生的影响，这可能是由于数据可用性有限。我们利用有关企业采用人工智能技术的独特调查数据，并以德国企业为样本估计其对生产力的影响。我们使用横截面数据集和面板数据库。为了解决人工智能采用的潜在内生性，我们还实现了 IV 估计器。我们发现人工智能的使用与企业生产力之间存在积极且显着的关联。这一发现适用于人工智能使用的不同衡量标准，即人工智能采用的指标变量，以及企业在业务流程中使用人工智能方法的强度。

articles.title_en: Forced displacement and migrants' location choices: Evidence from the Japanese-Canadian experience during World War II
articles.title_cn: 强制迁移与移民的选址决策：来自二战期间日裔加拿大人经历的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines whether a forced displacement of an ethnic group can lead to long-run changes to their spatial distribution and whether this shock can also lead to changes in where new migrants settle. I use the Canadian government’s internment of Japanese Canadians during World War II, as well as their post-war forced resettlement, as a natural experiment. I find that the policy led to dramatic resettlement patterns; areas where Japanese Canadians were removed from had far fewer Japanese Canadians after World War II, with this effect persisting for decades. Despite these displacement patterns, I find that both the pre-war and post-war settlement patterns drive where new Japanese migrants settle within Canada, suggesting that the disruption of the connections and networks formed by Japanese migrants before World War II were not fully dismantled by the Canadian government’s wartime policies. Reinforcing this mechanism, I show using Facebook’s social connectedness data that Japanese population shares from both 1931 and 1951 predict whether a Canadian Census Division is more socially connected with Japan today. The results from this paper show that, despite Canada’s forced dispersal of its Japanese population across the country, networks and forces that connect Census Divisions to Japan and draw in new migrants continued to persist.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了一个族裔群体的强制迁移是否会导致其空间分布的长期变化，以及这一冲击是否也会导致新移民定居地点的变化。我利用加拿大政府在二战期间对日裔加拿大人的拘禁以及战后强制重新安置作为自然实验。我发现该政策导致了戏剧性的重新安置模式；日裔加拿大人被迁出的地区在二战后日裔加拿大人数量大幅减少，且这一效应持续数十年。尽管存在这些迁移模式，我发现战前和战后的定居模式共同决定了新的日裔移民在加拿大境内的定居地点，这表明二战前日裔移民形成的联系和网络并未被加拿大政府的战时政策完全瓦解。为强化这一机制，我使用Facebook的社交连接数据显示，来自1931年和1951年的日裔人口比例能够预测当今加拿大人口普查分区与日本的社会连接程度。本文的结果表明，尽管加拿大对其日裔人口进行了全国范围内的强制分散，但连接人口普查分区与日本并吸引新移民的网络和力量持续存在。

articles.title_en: Do women shy away from risky skill games?
articles.title_cn: 女性是否回避高风险技能游戏？
articles.abstract_en: A risky skill game is a game in which skill plays an important role but outcomes are also strongly influenced by random factors. Examples are poker or blackjack but also many economic activities like trading on financial markets. In an online experiment we let subjects choose how often they want to play a risky skill game. We find that women play only half as many rounds in risky skill games with high variance. In contrast, there is no gender difference if the outcomes depend exclusively on chance or (mostly) on skill. Our results indicate that previous research on gender effects in risky environments (such as tournaments) may have greater applicability than previously thought.
articles.abstract_cn: 高风险技能游戏是一种技能发挥重要作用但结果也受到随机因素强烈影响的游戏。例如扑克或二十一点，但也包括许多经济活动，如金融市场交易。在一项在线实验中，我们让受试者选择他们想要玩高风险技能游戏的次数。我们发现，在高方差的高风险技能游戏中，女性玩的轮数仅为男性的一半。相比之下，如果结果完全取决于运气或（大部分）取决于技能，则不存在性别差异。我们的结果表明，先前关于风险环境（如锦标赛）中性别效应的研究可能具有比先前认为的更广泛的适用性。

articles.title_en: Random network consideration: Theory and experiment
articles.title_cn: 随机网络考虑：理论与实验
articles.abstract_en: In many settings, it is natural to think of limited consideration exhibiting spillovers: attention paid to a particular alternative may “spill over” to another alternative based on shared characteristics, complementarities, features of the choice environment, shared advertising campaigns, product bundling, etc. Limited consideration of this form gives rise to new methods of revealing preferences and attention. Using a novel laboratory experiment, I test the attention properties of a deterministic Network Consideration model proposed in previous work and find a plethora of violations thereof, even at the individual level. I then propose a stochastic generalization, Random Network Consideration, and analyze its properties regarding the formation of consideration sets. When applied to the laboratory data, I find greater consistency with the general Random Network Consideration model. These results reveal that intuitively appealing features of theories of limited attention may indeed be too stringent in practice, an insight which should guide future theoretical research.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多情境中，自然可以认为有限考虑表现出溢出效应：对某一特定备选方案的关注可能基于共同特征、互补性、选择环境特征、共享广告活动、产品捆绑等而“溢出”到另一备选方案。这种形式的有限考虑产生了揭示偏好和关注的新方法。通过一项新颖的实验室实验，我检验了先前工作中提出的确定性网络考虑模型的关注属性，并发现大量违反该模型的情况，即使在个体层面也是如此。随后，我提出了一个随机推广模型，即随机网络考虑，并分析了其在考虑集形成方面的性质。当应用于实验室数据时，我发现与一般随机网络考虑模型具有更高的一致性。这些结果表明，有限关注理论中直观吸引人的特征在实践中可能确实过于严格，这一见解应指导未来的理论研究。

articles.title_en: The gender gap among top business executives
articles.title_cn: 高层企业高管中的性别差距
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines gender differences among top US business executives using a large executive-employer matched data set spanning the last quarter century. Female executives make up 6% of the sample and exhibit more labor market churning – both higher entry and higher exit rates. Unconditionally, women earn 26% less than men, which decreases to 8% once executive characteristics, firm characteristics, and in particular job title are accounted for. We find that female executives are disproportionately represented in firms with more temporal flexibility and female-friendly corporate cultures, but this does not explain the gender pay gap. Rather, corporate culture is correlated with gender pay gaps within firms; specifically the within-firm gender pay gap is significantly smaller at female-friendly firms.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用覆盖过去四分之一个世纪的大型高管-雇主匹配数据集，考察了美国高层企业高管中的性别差异。女性高管占样本的6%%，并表现出更高的劳动力市场流动性——无论是进入率还是退出率都更高。无条件地看，女性收入比男性低26%%，但在考虑高管特征、企业特征，特别是职位头衔后，这一差距缩小至8%%。我们发现，女性高管在提供更多时间灵活性和女性友好企业文化的公司中比例过高，但这并不能解释性别薪酬差距。相反，企业文化与公司内部的性别薪酬差距相关；具体而言，在女性友好的公司中，公司内部的性别薪酬差距显著更小。

articles.title_en: Coordinating donations via an intermediary: The destructive effect of a sunk overhead cost
articles.title_cn: 通过中介协调捐赠：沉没间接费用的破坏性影响
articles.abstract_en: Donors often use the services of an intermediary to prevent their donations from being too thinly distributed over multiple public projects. We explore whether donors’ willingness to coordinate their funds via an intermediary depends on the extent of the intermediary’s discretion over their contributions, as well as the organizational overhead costs incurred by the intermediary. We investigate this using a laboratory experiment in which donors face multiple identical threshold public goods and the opportunity to coordinate their contributions via another donor assigned to the role of intermediary. In line with standard game theoretic predictions, we find that donors make use of the intermediary only when they know she is heavily restricted in terms of the proportion of their contributions she can expropriate for herself. However, we find strong evidence that the positive effect of these restrictions is undone once the intermediary incurs a sunk overhead cost. Our analysis suggests that the ex-ante inequality created as a result of this sunk cost reduces the trustworthiness of the intermediary in the donors’ eyes, which in turn reduces the donors’ willingness to use the intermediary to coordinate their contributions effectively.
articles.abstract_cn: 捐赠者通常使用中介服务，以防止其捐赠在多个公共项目中被过度分散。我们探讨捐赠者通过中介协调资金的意愿是否取决于中介对其捐款的自由裁量权程度，以及中介产生的组织间接费用。我们通过实验室实验对此进行研究，实验中捐赠者面临多个相同的门槛公共物品，并有机会通过另一名被指定为中介的捐赠者来协调其捐款。与标准博弈论预测一致，我们发现只有当捐赠者知道中介在可为自己侵占的捐款比例方面受到严格限制时，他们才会利用中介。然而，我们发现强有力的证据表明，一旦中介产生沉没间接费用，这些限制的积极效应就会被抵消。我们的分析表明，这种沉没成本导致的先验不平等降低了捐赠者眼中中介的可信度，进而降低了捐赠者利用中介有效协调其捐款的意愿。

articles.title_en: The effect of quantity and quality of information in strategy tournaments
articles.title_cn: 策略锦标赛中信息数量与质量的影响
articles.abstract_en: It is increasingly common for algorithms rather than people to take complex decisions. Many of those algorithms are however written by people and the information available to them when developing an algorithm will influence the algorithm they write. We implement such a setting in a controlled environment where participants program an explicit strategy to play the minority game on their behalf in a multi-round strategy tournament. The minority game is a stylized example of the large and important class of games with strategic substitutes such as market-entry and congestion games. Given the large strategy space and multiplicity of equilibria of the minority game, developing a successful strategy is no easy task. Over three experiments we vary the information available to participants to study whether more or better information can help people to improve their strategies over time. Providing participants with the strategies played by others turns out to reduce overall performance, while reducing the noise in feedback about the potential performance of a strategy under consideration increases efficiency. We argue that these different information structures put different types of strategies in a good light. The increased popularity of the favored strategies in turn drives overall efficiency.
articles.abstract_cn: 由算法而非人类做出复杂决策的情况日益普遍。然而，许多此类算法是由人类编写的，他们在开发算法时可获得的信息将影响他们编写的算法。我们在受控环境中实现了这样一种设置，参与者编写明确的策略，在多轮策略锦标赛中代表他们玩少数派博弈。少数派博弈是战略替代品这一大类重要博弈（如市场进入和拥堵博弈）的一个典型例子。鉴于少数派博弈的策略空间庞大且均衡多重，制定成功的策略并非易事。在三个实验中，我们改变参与者可获得的信息，以研究更多或更好的信息是否能帮助人们随时间改进其策略。向参与者提供他人采用的策略反而降低了整体绩效，而减少关于所考虑策略潜在绩效反馈中的噪声则提高了效率。我们认为，这些不同的信息结构使不同类型的策略显得更具优势。受青睐策略的日益普及反过来又推动了整体效率的提升。

articles.title_en: Clash of norms judicial leniency on defendant birthdays
articles.title_cn: 规范的冲突：被告生日当天的司法宽大处理
articles.abstract_en: We document judicial leniency on defendant birthdays across 4.8 million decisions. Our results are consistent with reference-dependent social preferences. First, French sentences are 1% fewer and around 5% shorter. Second, U.S. federal judges also round down sentences except when rounding up makes available sentencing reductions for good behavior. No leniency appears on the days before or after a defendant's birthday.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了在4.8百万个判决中，被告生日当天存在司法宽大处理现象。我们的结果与参照依赖的社会偏好一致。首先，法国的刑期减少了1%，且刑期长度缩短了约5%。其次，美国联邦法官也会向下取整刑期，除非向上取整能够使良好行为获得减刑机会。在被告生日前后几天，没有出现宽大处理现象。

articles.title_en: Safety first, loss probability, and the cross section of expected stock returns
articles.title_cn: 安全第一、损失概率与股票预期收益率的横截面
articles.abstract_en: Recent studies show that loss probability (LP) is a decisive factor when people evaluate assets in laboratory experiments, suggesting a positive relationship between LP and expected stock returns. This corresponds to the classical “Safety-First” principle. We find strong empirical support for this prediction in the U.S. stock market. During our sample period, average risk-adjusted return differences between stocks in the two extreme LP deciles exceed 0.57% per month. The positive LP effect, characterized by the intention of some investors to pay low prices for high LP stocks, remains significant after controlling for traditional downside risk measures.
articles.abstract_cn: 近期研究表明，损失概率（LP）是人们在实验室实验中评估资产时的决定性因素，表明LP与预期股票收益率之间存在正相关关系。这符合经典的“安全第一”原则。我们在美国股票市场中找到了对这一预测的强有力的实证支持。在我们的样本期间，两个极端LP十分位组股票之间的平均风险调整后收益率差异每月超过0.57%。正向LP效应，其特征是一些投资者愿意为高LP股票支付低价格，在控制传统下行风险度量后仍然显著。

articles.title_en: Individualism reduces borrower discouragement
articles.title_cn: 个人主义减少借款人沮丧情绪
articles.abstract_en: Borrower discouragement contributes to reducing access to credit worldwide. In this study, we examine whether individualism influences the discouragement of borrowers. We used data on borrower discouragement and individualism at the firm level for a large dataset of 31,000 firms from 57 countries. We find that firms in individualistic countries are less likely to be discouraged from applying for loans. Furthermore, individualistic norms reduce borrower discouragement through their impact on lower corruption in lending and weak informal support networks. Our results hold after controlling for other cultural dimensions, addressing potential endogeneity and sample selection issues. Thus, our findings indicate that individualism reduces borrower discouragement, thereby improving access to credit of firms.
articles.abstract_cn: 借款人沮丧情绪在全球范围内减少了信贷获取。在本研究中，我们考察个人主义是否影响借款人的沮丧情绪。我们使用了来自57个国家的大型数据集，包含31,000家企业的借款人沮丧情绪和个人主义的企业层面数据。我们发现，个人主义国家的企业不太可能因申请贷款而感到沮丧。此外，个人主义规范通过降低贷款腐败和弱化非正式支持网络来减少借款人沮丧情绪。在控制其他文化维度、解决潜在内生性和样本选择问题后，我们的结果依然稳健。因此，我们的研究结果表明，个人主义减少了借款人沮丧情绪，从而改善了企业的信贷获取。

articles.title_en: Information avoidance: Self-image concerns, inattention, and ideology
articles.title_cn: 信息回避：自我形象关注、疏忽与意识形态
articles.abstract_en: We report the results of an experiment on willful information avoidance regarding measures to address Covid-19. In the experiment, participants choose between two options, each associated with a contribution to the Corona Fund of the Red Cross USA and a payment to the participant. Depending on the treatment, either the participants’ payoff, the donation, both or none of these pieces of information were hidden, but revealable. With this design, we can separate motivated reasons for ignorance from non-motivated reasons, both of which are present in our data. Furthermore, we find evidence of both self-serving and pro-social information avoidance. These behavioral patterns correlate with the subjects’ political attitudes: while voters of the Democratic Party are prone to exhibit pro-social information avoidance, Republican voters rather engage in self-serving information avoidance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们报告了一项关于针对应对Covid-19措施的有意信息回避实验的结果。在实验中，参与者需要在两个选项之间做出选择，每个选项都与对美国红十字会新冠基金的捐款以及支付给参与者的款项相关联。根据处理方式的不同，参与者的收益、捐款、两者或两者都不被隐藏，但可以揭示。通过这种设计，我们可以将出于动机的忽视原因与非动机的原因区分开来，这两者在我们的数据中均存在。此外，我们发现了利己和亲社会信息回避的证据。这些行为模式与受试者的政治态度相关：民主党选民倾向于表现出亲社会信息回避，而共和党选民则更倾向于进行利己信息回避。

articles.title_en: A theory of hypocrisy
articles.title_cn: 伪善理论
articles.abstract_en: This paper explains the occurrence of hypocrisy – when the by-society most despised types pretend to be the most revered types. Real-world phenomena include pedophile priests, sex-offender feminists and seemingly very busy dispensable office workers. Building on the signaling framework of Bernheim (1994) – where payoffs consist of an intrinsic cost of falsifying yourself, and a concern for social esteem – we show conditions for emergence of hypocrisy in equilibrium. In such equilibria the most despised types along with the most revered types behave normatively, others do not. Thus, in equilibrium there are ‘rumors’ about those acting the most normatively – society infers that they are either truly normative or despised, but one cannot know who is who. This is to be distinguished from ‘conformity’ – where the most normative and almost-normative types fully follow a social norm. Whether conformity or hypocrisy will arise in equilibrium depends on the cost of falsification, and the number of hypocrites depends on the weight of social esteem. Our theory thus shows how cultural parameters map into equilibrium culture.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文解释了伪善的发生——即当社会最鄙视的类型假装成最受尊敬的类型时。现实世界中的现象包括恋童癖牧师、性犯罪者女权主义者以及看似非常忙碌但可有可无的办公室职员。基于伯恩海姆（1994）的信号传递框架——其中收益由伪装自我的内在成本和对社会尊重的关注组成——我们展示了伪善在均衡中出现的条件。在这种均衡中，最受鄙视的类型与最受尊敬的类型一起表现得规范，而其他人则不然。因此，在均衡中，关于那些表现得最规范的人存在“谣言”——社会推断他们要么是真正规范的，要么是被鄙视的，但人们无法知道谁是谁。这要与“从众”区分开来——在从众中，最规范的和几乎规范的类型完全遵循社会规范。均衡中出现从众还是伪善取决于伪装成本，而伪善者的数量取决于社会尊重的权重。因此，我们的理论展示了文化参数如何映射到均衡文化中。

articles.title_en: Sponsor, institutional investor, and quotation behavior: Theory and evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 保荐人、机构投资者与报价行为：来自中国的理论与证据
articles.abstract_en: How do interactions between institutional investors and sponsors affect the quotations in IPOs? This paper provides evidence that connections between the above two agencies result in variations in the institutional investors’ quoted prices and quotation frequency in China stock market. Using a Bartik-style identification strategy that links shocks to connections between institutional investors and sponsors in China, we find that a stronger connection between a sponsor and an institutional investor lowers the quoted price to a realistic level and increases the probability that the investor joins the quotation of the sponsor’s main-board IPO during the “three highs” period in which the “favor quotation” is common. This relationship will be more significant for quotation frequency when more investors are connected to sponsors within a city. Moreover, the mouth-to-mouth effect tends to be weaker in cities with more investors.
articles.abstract_cn: 机构投资者与保荐人之间的互动如何影响首次公开募股（IPO）中的报价？本文提供的证据表明，在中国股票市场中，上述两个机构之间的联系导致了机构投资者报价和报价频率的差异。利用一种巴蒂克式识别策略，该策略将中国机构投资者与保荐人之间联系的冲击联系起来，我们发现，保荐人与机构投资者之间更强的联系会将报价降低至现实水平，并增加投资者参与保荐人主板IPO报价的概率，尤其是在“三高”时期，此时“人情报价”较为普遍。当城市内更多投资者与保荐人相关联时，这种关系对报价频率的影响将更为显著。此外，口碑效应在投资者较多的城市中往往较弱。

articles.title_en: Social norms offer explanation for inconsistent effects of incentives on prosocial behavior
articles.title_cn: 社会规范解释了激励对亲社会行为影响的不一致性
articles.abstract_en: Humans are widely considered to be susceptible to incentives, which are frequently employed to encourage specific behaviors. However, incentives have surprisingly inconsistent effects when used to motivate prosocial behavior – sometimes producing no behavioral change or even backfiring. To explain these inconsistencies, we extended a prominent image-based model of prosocial behavior, based on the idea that social norms shape the reputational consequences of receiving incentives. We tested the key predictions of this model by examining the blood donation behavior of 26,000 individuals from 28 European countries. Our preregistered analyses revealed that social norms can indeed predict how incentives, either in the form of financial payments or time off work, relate to individual-level blood donation behavior. Incentives are associated with higher levels of prosociality if they align with existing norms. The results suggest that humans may not be universally persuaded by incentives to behave prosocially, but that the effectiveness of incentives depends on social norms.
articles.abstract_cn: 人类被广泛认为容易受到激励的影响，激励常被用来鼓励特定行为。然而，当激励用于激发亲社会行为时，其效果却出人意料地不一致——有时不产生行为变化，甚至适得其反。为了解释这些不一致性，我们扩展了一个基于形象的亲社会行为模型，该模型基于社会规范塑造接受激励的声誉后果这一理念。我们通过考察来自28个欧洲国家的26,000名个体的献血行为，检验了该模型的关键预测。我们的预注册分析揭示，社会规范确实可以预测激励（无论是金钱报酬还是工作时间休假）如何与个体层面的献血行为相关联。当激励与现有规范一致时，它们与更高水平的亲社会性相关。结果表明，人类可能并非普遍被激励所说服而表现出亲社会行为，而是激励的有效性取决于社会规范。

articles.title_en: Classical and Keynesian models of inequality and stagnation
articles.title_cn: 不平等与停滞的古典和凯恩斯模型
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies two formal models of long run growth with a medium-run distributive cycle, both of which feature causal links from the rise in inequality to a deterioration of long run macroeconomic performance. Both versions feature an endogenous income-capital ratio: one through the Keynesian notion of effective demand, the other building on induced bias in technical change. A key focus of the analysis is on the assumptions necessary in both frameworks to generate policy implications consistent with the observed decline of the labor share, the income-capital ratio, and labor productivity growth during the neoliberal era. Importantly, both theories: (a) provide space for mutually reinforcing pro-labor and pro-growth policies in the long run, although they differ in the mechanisms at play in these processes; (b) imply a potential tradeoff between pro-labor policies and growth on one hand, and long-run employment on the other; (c) are consistent with the evidence on the distributive cycle at business cycle frequency.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了两个具有中期分配周期的长期增长正式模型，两者都包含了从不平等加剧到长期宏观经济表现恶化的因果联系。两个版本都包含内生性的收入-资本比率：一个通过凯恩斯有效需求概念，另一个基于技术变革中的诱导性偏差。分析的一个关键焦点是，在两种框架中，为产生与新自由主义时代观察到的劳动份额、收入-资本比率和劳动生产率增长下降相一致的政策含义所需假设。重要的是，两种理论：（a）在长期内为相互加强的亲劳动和亲增长政策提供了空间，尽管它们在作用机制上有所不同；（b）暗示了亲劳动政策与增长之间以及长期就业之间的潜在权衡；（c）与商业周期频率上的分配周期证据一致。

articles.title_en: Mobile phone coverage and infant mortality in sub-Saharan Africa
articles.title_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲的手机覆盖与婴儿死亡率
articles.abstract_en: Infant mortality is still high in Sub-Saharan Africa. Mobile phone technology has the potential to reduce mortality by facilitating the exchange of information. To test for effects, we combine georeferenced information on mobile phone signal coverage with infant mortality data on 1,268,041 children born in 30 Sub-Saharan African countries between 1999–2016. Our results reveal that infant mortality risk drops substantially as mobile phone coverage expands. Infants are 0.9 percentage points less likely to die within the first year after birth compared to their sibling(s) when mobile phone signal is available. In line with this result, we also find that fertility rates decline with the rollout of mobile coverage. Suggestive evidence indicates that improved health knowledge is relevant in explaining our findings. Mobile-phone related changes in access to in-person healthcare services or improvements in income opportunities, on the other hand, are unlikely to play an important role.
articles.abstract_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲的婴儿死亡率仍然很高。手机技术有可能通过促进信息交流来降低死亡率。为了检验其影响，我们将手机信号覆盖的地理参考信息与1999-2016年间在30个撒哈拉以南非洲国家出生的1,268,041名儿童的婴儿死亡率数据相结合。我们的结果显示，随着手机覆盖范围的扩大，婴儿死亡风险显著下降。当有手机信号时，婴儿在出生后第一年内死亡的可能性比其兄弟姐妹低0.9个百分点。与这一结果一致，我们还发现生育率随着手机覆盖的推广而下降。提示性证据表明，健康知识的改善是解释我们发现的相关因素。另一方面，手机相关的变化对获得面对面医疗服务的机会或收入机会的改善，则不太可能发挥重要作用。

articles.title_en: Do immigrants affect crime? Evidence for Germany
articles.title_cn: 移民是否影响犯罪？来自德国的证据
articles.abstract_en: The paper empirically analyses the causal relationship between immigrants and crime using data for German administrative districts between 2008 and 2019. Before the refugee crisis (2008–2014), an increase in the current share of immigrants increased the total crime rate. In contrast, the effect was negative (or insignificant) during and after the refugee crisis (2015–2019). When analysing the total period, the estimates average out to zero. Studying more closely the composition of the migrant group, a plausible explanation of the negative (or insignificant) effect of immigrants on crime in the later period is related to a larger share of migrants with a less certain residence status.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用2008年至2019年德国行政区的数据，实证分析了移民与犯罪之间的因果关系。在难民危机之前（2008-2014年），当前移民比例的增加提高了总犯罪率。相比之下，在难民危机期间及之后（2015-2019年），这一效应为负（或不显著）。在分析整个时期时，估计值平均为零。更仔细地研究移民群体的构成，后期移民对犯罪产生负面（或不显著）影响的一个合理解释与居留身份不确定的移民比例较大有关。

articles.title_en: Assessing linkages between alternative energy markets and cryptocurrencies
articles.title_cn: 评估替代能源市场与加密货币之间的关联
articles.abstract_en: Surmounted environmental concerns and energy challenges have created an augmented awareness among the public and policymakers about alternate energy resources. Using a network approach, this paper aims to investigate the dependence between cryptocurrencies and the alternative energy market using data from January 1, 2018, to December 23, 2021. For this investigation, first, we build a static dependency network for a given set of variables using partial correlations. Then, we demonstrate within-system connections in a minimum spanning tree (MST) to assess the centrality of all variables. Finally, rolling-window estimations are made to exhibit time variations in both dependency and centrality networks. We find that clean alternative markets (SPGCE, ELEVHC & WILCE) and ETH are net risk transmitters to other markets and system-wide net contributors. We also demonstrate how SPGCE is essential for tying together the various parts of the networks and provide convincing evidence of time-varying within-system dependency. Our thorough examination of the dependency analysis offers significant insights to macroprudential regulators, policymakers, and portfolio managers, enabling them to safeguard the most vulnerable markets and choose the best legislative and policy measures to protect investors' interests in the face of unforeseen financial and economic conditions.
articles.abstract_cn: 日益严峻的环境问题和能源挑战已使公众和政策制定者对替代能源资源有了更高的认识。本文采用网络方法，利用2018年一月1日至2021年十二月23日的数据，旨在研究加密货币与替代能源市场之间的依赖性。为此，我们首先使用偏相关为给定变量集构建静态依赖网络。然后，我们在最小生成树（MST）中展示系统内连接，以评估所有变量的中心性。最后，进行滚动窗口估计以展示依赖性和中心性网络的时间变化。我们发现清洁替代市场（SPGCE、ELEVHC和WILCE）和ETH是其他市场和系统范围内净风险传递者，也是系统范围内的净贡献者。我们还展示了SPGCE在连接网络各部分中的关键作用，并提供了系统内依赖性随时间变化的令人信服的证据。我们对依赖性分析的全面考察为宏观审慎监管者、政策制定者和投资组合经理提供了重要见解，使他们能够保护最脆弱的市场，并选择最佳的立法和政策措施，以在不可预见的金融和经济条件下保护投资者的利益。

articles.title_en: No evidence of biased updating in beliefs about absolute performance: A replication and generalization of Grossman and Owens (2012)
articles.title_cn: 关于绝对绩效信念不存在偏误更新的证据：对Grossman和Owens（2012）的重复与推广
articles.abstract_en: Many studies report that following feedback, individuals do not update their beliefs enough (a conservatism bias), and react more to good news than to bad news (an asymmetry bias), consistent with the idea of motivated beliefs. In the literature on conservatism and asymmetric updating, however, only one prior study focuses on judgments on absolute performance (Grossman & Owens, 2012), which finds that belief updating is well described by the Bayesian benchmark in that case. Here, we set out to test the replicability of these results and their robustness across several experimental manipulations, varying the uncertainty of participants’ priors, the tasks to perform, the format of beliefs and the elicitation rules used to incentivize these beliefs. We also introduce new measures of ego-relevance of these beliefs, and of the credibility of the feedback received by participants. Overall, we confirm across various experimental conditions that individuals exhibit no conservatism and asymmetry bias when they update their beliefs about their absolute performance. As in Grossman & Owens (2012), most observations are well-described by a Bayesian benchmark in our data. These results suggest a limit to the manifestation of motivated beliefs, and call for more research on the conditions under which biases in belief updating occur.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多研究报告称，在收到反馈后，个体没有充分更新他们的信念（保守主义偏误），并且对好消息的反应比对坏消息更强烈（不对称偏误），这与动机性信念的观点一致。然而，在关于保守主义和不对称更新的文献中，只有一项先前的研究关注绝对绩效的判断（Grossman & Owens, 2012），该研究发现，在这种情况下，信念更新很好地由贝叶斯基准描述。在此，我们旨在检验这些结果的可重复性及其在多种实验操作中的稳健性，这些操作改变了参与者先验的不确定性、要执行的任务、信念的形式以及用于激励这些信念的引出规则。我们还引入了这些信念的自我相关性和参与者收到的反馈可信度的新度量。总体而言，我们确认在各种实验条件下，个体在更新关于其绝对绩效的信念时没有表现出保守主义和不对称偏误。与Grossman和Owens（2012）一样，在我们的数据中，大多数观察结果很好地由贝叶斯基准描述。这些结果表明动机性信念的表现存在限制，并呼吁对信念更新偏误发生的条件进行更多研究。

articles.title_en: The epidemic effect: Epidemics, institutions and human capital development
articles.title_cn: 流行病效应：流行病、制度与人力资本发展
articles.abstract_en: Epidemics can negatively affect economic development unless they are mitigated by global governance institutions. We examine the effects of sudden exposure to epidemics on human capital outcomes using evidence from the African meningitis belt. Meningitis shocks reduce child health outcomes, particularly when the World Health Organization (WHO) does not declare an epidemic year. These effects are reversed when the WHO declares an epidemic year. Children born in meningitis shock areas in a year when an epidemic is declared are 10 percentage points (pp) less stunted and 8.2 pp less underweight than their peers born in non-epidemic years. We find evidence for the crowd-out of routine vaccination during epidemic years. We analyze data from World Bank projects and find evidence that an influx of health aid in response to WHO declarations may partly explain these reversals.
articles.abstract_cn: 流行病会对经济发展产生负面影响，除非全球治理机构能够缓解其影响。我们利用非洲脑膜炎地带的证据，考察了突然暴露于流行病对人力资本结果的影响。脑膜炎冲击会降低儿童健康结果，尤其是在世界卫生组织（WHO）未宣布流行病年份的情况下。当WHO宣布流行病年份时，这些影响会发生逆转。在宣布流行病的年份，出生于脑膜炎冲击地区的儿童，其发育迟缓率比非流行病年份出生的同龄人低10个百分点（pp），体重不足率低8.2个百分点。我们发现了流行病年份常规疫苗接种被挤出的证据。我们分析了世界银行项目的数据，发现针对WHO宣布的卫生援助流入可能部分解释了这些逆转。
